market.headline: Selling speeds up after lunch: QQQ -2.3%, SPY -1.1%, TSLA under Thursday's low as chips and oil squeeze opex Friday
market.note: The afternoon got worse, not better. SPY slid from its 772 open area to about 763 and QQQ broke the 715 support traders were watching, trading near 711. Chips are down another 3% on day nine of the skid, and oil jumped back toward 100 on new Iran alerts, which revives the inflation worry right after hot import prices. TSLA lost Thursday's 355 low. Into the opex close, watch whether SPY can reclaim 766 or keeps pressing toward the lows.

portfolio.note: Deeper red this afternoon. The TSLA stack (TSLA, TSLL, TSLW) is down about 3 to 6% and QLD about 4.7% as the QQQ drop doubles. The week is mostly the TSLA slide from last Friday.

catalyst.outlook: Two inflation forces are hitting at once. Hot import prices and strong industrial production this morning already trimmed rate-cut hopes before the Oct 27-28 Fed meeting, and now oil is spiking back toward 100 on Iran alerts. That combo hits long-duration tech first, which is why QQQ is down twice as much as SPY and chips are on day nine. If oil holds above 100 into next week, growth names stay under pressure into Wednesday night, when TSLA and META both report.

today.name: Import Prices (Sep)
today.read: Hotter than expected and August was revised down to 0.5%. Fuel imports rose 4.8% and nonfuel 0.7%. Year over year import prices are up 8.1%, the largest gain since July 2022. That keeps pressure on yields and growth names like TSLA and QQQ even as the index holds near highs.

today.name: Industrial Production (Sep)
today.read: A clear beat. Manufacturing rose 0.3%, utilities jumped 3.5%, and third-quarter IP ran at a 2.8% annual rate. Growth is holding up despite hot energy costs, which softens the stagflation read from this week's inflation prints.

today.name: Capacity Utilization (Sep)
today.read: Utilization moved up but remains 2.5 points below its long-run average, so factory tightness is not the main inflation driver. Still a mild hawkish tilt alongside hot import prices.

today.name: Monthly options expiration
today.read: Big SPY and QQQ option positions roll off today, which can pin prices near large strikes and cause sharp moves in the last hour.

week.name: Cboe extended options hours begin
week.why: Early morning and late sessions start for SPY, QQQ and more. Expect thinner liquidity and wider spreads in those windows.

week.name: NAHB Housing Market Index (Oct)
week.why: Builder mood with mortgage rates above 7%. A read on how rates are biting the housing side of the economy.

week.name: Housing Starts and Building Permits (Sep)
week.why: More housing data. Weak numbers would support the case for easier policy despite hot inflation.

week.name: Netflix earnings (after the close)
week.why: First mega-cap tech report of the season. Sets the tone for growth names into TSLA and META.

week.name: TSLA, META, IBM, LRCX, TXN earnings (after the close)
week.why: The big one for you. TSLA margins, robotaxi and Roadster plans, plus META AI spend and LRCX and TXN reads on the chip slump.

week.name: Initial Jobless Claims
week.why: Claims have hovered near 200K. A jump would be the first crack in the labor market.

week.name: S&P Global Flash PMIs (Oct)
week.why: First look at October activity and price pressures. Watch the prices-paid parts for oil pass-through.

week.name: UMich Sentiment, final (Oct)
week.why: Inflation expectations matter here. Rising expectations would make the Fed's job harder the week before its meeting.

stocks.title: QQQ and SPY slide harder on opex Friday
stocks.detail: Traders flagged a gamma cliff near SPY 772 and max pain near 770; SPY has since dropped through both toward 763. QQQ broke the 715 to 724 support zone many were watching.

stocks.title: Chip stocks extend the longest losing streak in over a decade
stocks.detail: SOXX is down another 3% today after eight straight losses, the longest run in over a decade. AI spend doubts and higher borrowing costs are the main blame on X.

stocks.title: Oil jumps back toward 100 on Iran high alert reports
stocks.detail: USO is up about 2.8% and XLE about 2.2% today after reports of Iran forces on highest alert and more tanker attacks. Higher oil feeds the inflation fear hitting tech.

stocks.title: AI data-center stocks Nebius and IREN drop on funding worries
stocks.detail: A Gartner warning that most neocloud providers may not stay independent by 2030 is circulating. IREN is down about 10% today, the worst on your watchlist.

tech.title: China proposes export limits on 23 AI technologies
tech.detail: Draft rules would require approval to export large model weights and source code, AI agents and computing clusters. Comments are open until Nov 15. Another step in the AI chip and tech standoff.

tech.title: Slovakia becomes the ninth EU country to approve Tesla Assisted Driving
tech.detail: The system formerly called FSD Supervised is cleared there, covering about 14% of the EU population across nine countries. Germany and other big markets are still waiting.

tech.title: Sam Altman says AI disruption is slower than he expected
tech.detail: On a podcast he said habits and company inertia slowed the impact he predicted after GPT-4, even as Big Tech keeps borrowing heavily for AI buildouts.

tech.title: Terence Tao says math's era of lone heroes is ending
tech.detail: He described a shift to team and AI-driven math. Anthropic and OpenAI each pledged funding through the Simons Foundation to help verify AI-generated results.

world.title: Iran vows to push US Navy ships farther from its coast
world.detail: Iran says US warships are 500 km out and plans operations to push them farther, after strikes on commercial ships near Hormuz. Oil flows and prices stay on edge.

world.title: Indonesia stocks crash 11% on MSCI downgrade threat
world.detail: The worst drop since 1998 triggered a trading halt after MSCI proposed moving Indonesia out of emerging market status. Analysts warn of large foreign outflows.

world.title: WhatsApp outage hits parts of Europe
world.detail: Messages stuck on one gray tick in the UK, Germany, Spain and Italy this afternoon. WABetaInfo says it is regional, not global.

world.title: FIFA reviews the Peace Prize it gave Trump
world.detail: FIFA's council asked a committee to review how the prize was created and whether to keep, reform or scrap it, with a recommendation due Dec 16.

fact.claim: October is historically the S&P 500's worst month on average.
fact.explain: October has the scary reputation because of the 1929 and 1987 crashes, but its average return is positive. September is the month that has been weakest on average over the long run.

word.definition: Mental calm and steadiness, especially when things are stressful or going against you.
word.example: After a rough week, he met the premarket bounce with equanimity and stuck to his plan.

gbot.name: GROK
gbot.say: TSLA just cracked Thursday's 355 low and QQQ lost 715. Rough opex Friday, and Rice is officially out Sunday.

items.title: TSLA broke Thursday's low
items.detail: Thursday's low was 355.23 and today's low so far is about 351 after a 370 high this morning. That is a full reversal of the Roadster pop. A close back above 355 would look much better heading into Wednesday's earnings.

items.title: Oil is the new drag on tech
items.detail: USO is up about 2.8% today on Iran alert reports while QQQ falls 2.3%. Higher oil means hotter inflation and fewer rate cuts, which is the exact setup that hits QLD and the TSLA stack hardest.

items.title: META reports Wednesday with TSLA
items.detail: META is down about 4% today and both report after the close on Oct 21. That night is the biggest event for your watchlist next week.

items.title: Lakers wrap preseason tonight vs Denver
items.detail: Final tune-up at Crypto.com Arena before the regular season starts Oct 20. The roster has to be at 15 by Monday, and a Knecht waiver is still possible if no trade lands.

sports.title: Rashee Rice ruled out vs the Chargers
sports.detail: Andy Reid confirmed Friday that Rice is out with hamstring and knee issues, his first missed game this year. LT Josh Simmons is also out but did return to practice this week.

sports.title: Chiefs host the 0-5 Chargers Sunday at Arrowhead
sports.detail: KC is without Rice, so more targets shift elsewhere. Sneed was limited Wed and Thu; check his final status before locking anything in.

sports.title: Khalil Mack trade buzz around the Chargers
sports.detail: The Bears lead reported interest and the 49ers have called, but Mack says he is still ring chasing with LA. The trade deadline is Nov 10.

sports.title: Lakers face the Nuggets in tonight's preseason finale
sports.detail: Last exhibition before the Oct 20 opener. Watch who sits and who closes games as a hint at the rotation.
